Fixtures for TXT, Markdown, DOCX, and PDF adapter preservation tests belong in this directory.

## DOCX

See [`docx/README.md`](docx/README.md) for the DOCX fixture matrix, which covers
headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, hyperlinks, images, headers/footers, nested
formatting, unsupported embedded objects, malformed packages, and large documents.

## Capability matrix

| Fixture | Headings | Lists | Tables | Links | Images | Headers/Footers | Nested runs | Unsupported features | Malformed | Large |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `docx/sample-rich.docx` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | – | – | – | – | – |
| `docx/header-footer.docx` | ✓ | – | – | – | – | ✓ | – | – | – | – |
| `docx/nested-formatting.docx` | – | – | – | – | – | – | ✓ | – | – | – |
| `docx/unsupported-object.docx` | ✓ | – | – | – | – | – | – | ✓ (OLE) | – | – |
| `docx/malformed-package.docx` | – | – | – | – | – | – | – | – | ✓ | – |
| `docx/large-document.docx` | – | – | – | – | – | – | – | – | – | ✓ |

DOCX fixtures are generated by `scripts/generate-docx-fixture.mjs`.
